regions.text: Automatic High Frequency Piezo Controller / SDVC42-SD

regions.text_excerpt: Customers can further access the acceleration sensor to realize automatic frequency search of the controller... Take out the sensor, connect the sensor plug to the controller...

Long press ▲ and ▼ enter frequency search interface... displays the amplitude curve... displays the output voltage, current, and acceleration values... displays "Save"... Users can further adjust the feeding speed...
